System clutter, junk, duplicate, and other unwanted files can fill up your storage space and slow down your Mac.
Keep your Mac running smoothly with quick system maintenance.
Keep your Mac running smoothly by scanning and deleting hidden junk and duplicate files.
Core Features
Smart Scan
Give your Mac a customized checkup with a single click.
Disk Cleaner
Safely delete junk, duplicate, large files, and similar-looking photos to free up storage space.
Start Up Manager
Optimize your Mac's startup by managing which items can automatically open.
App Cleaner & Manager
Manage app files by name, size, or date. Safely delete apps you don't need anymore.
File Shredder
Securely delete sensitive and private files so they become impossible to recover.
Vulnerbility Scanner
Keep your device safe from the latest threats with vulnerability scans and software updates.
Clean up your Mac
Make the most of your Mac by freeing up space
Say goodbye to junk files
Scan your Mac for unneeded, outdated files, and clean them up to free up disk space.
Delete hidden leftover files
Easily find and delete large and hidden files that may impact your Mac's performance without losing important files.
Get rid of duplicate files and similar photos
Recover storage space by finding and deleting copies of documents, photos, movies, downloads, and other hidden files.
Visualize Your Storage
Scan your Mac to visualize and analyze what's taking up your disk space.
Speed up your Mac
Improve performance and responsiveness
Turbo-charge your Mac
Is your Mac getting sluggish? Optimize your Mac's performance by preventing less frequently used apps from starting automatically. Ensure that your Mac is running at maximum performance.
Reduce startup time
Does your Mac take a long time to start? Manage items that automatically open when you login on your Mac and prevent adware items from opening.
Protect your Mac
Secure your digital life
Stay safe from security threats
Find out if your Mac is vulnerable by checking your operating system and apps against our industry-leading malware database for potential threats.
Remove adware
Free yourself from annoying adware.Locate and automatically remove risky adware that may be accidentally installed in your start up programs.
